target_warning: research proxy; not biopsy-confirmed nephritis and not for clinical diagnosis

cohort.eligibility: age>=20, eGFR<60 or ACR>=30, ANA actually measured
cohort.patient_id_separation: SEQN; every outer fold is patient-disjoint

protocol.threshold_selection: inner stratified CV only; maximizes balanced accuracy
protocol.selection: highest patient-pooled repeated-CV AUROC; all candidates reported
protocol.untouched_holdout: none for this new binary proxy; results are repeated nested CV, not external validation
